game_concept: A racing platformer set in Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome, a collapsed dome: the spirit seeker must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Queue Line: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome: a collapsed dome
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Dome, repeat each round: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the spirit seeker ahead. Then check the queue_calm value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the rune gate by solving code steps involving queue_calm that move the spirit seeker forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the rune gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Queue Line
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Queue Line' (Week 7 slot 4), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Collapsed Dome'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_calm changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Collapsed Dome.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
